final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tx.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg COLLATE BINARY = ab.translink COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg COLLATE BINARY = tx.trdref COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY tr.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count FROM step1) SELECT step1.tradekind, step1.transaction_count, 1.0 * step1.transaction_count / NULLIF(step2.total_count, 0) FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.total_count IS NOT NULL
